name: Tiami Catamaran Cruises
summary: Tiami Catamaran Cruises sails from the Shallow Draught in Bridgetown on a fleet of custom-built catamarans. The lunch cruise heads up the west coast to snorkel with turtles and over shipwrecks, with a buffet lunch, an open bar and hotel transfers included. There are also sunset cruises, a steel pan sunset sail twice a week, and private charters for weddings and events.
standouts: Round-trip hotel transfers on scheduled cruises
Live steel pan show on Tuesday and Saturday sunset cruises
Private charters with live music, barbecues and catering

trips.title: 5 Star Lunch Cruise
trips.summary: A day on a large custom-built catamaran along the west coast, snorkelling with turtles and over shipwrecks. A swim stop and buffet lunch come last, before an easy sail back down the coast.
highlights: Swim and snorkel stops with turtles and shipwrecks
trips.checkNotes: No price on the site; prices are only inside the Peek booking page (not opened). Unclear whether 9:30 am to 2:30 pm includes the hotel transfers.

trips.title: Tiami at Sunset
trips.summary: An evening cruise along the coast with a swim with the turtles shortly before sunset. Dinner is a full buffet, with an open bar and cocktails, and hotel transfers both ways.
highlights: Sunset swim, with the chance to swim with turtles
trips.checkNotes: No price, time or duration on the site; prices are only inside the Peek booking page (not opened).

trips.title: Pan on the Sea
trips.summary: A sunset cruise on Tuesdays and Saturdays with a live steel pan show on board. It includes a beach stop, a full buffet dinner and an open bar, with transfers both ways.
highlights: Full buffet dinner and open bar
trips.checkNotes: Book Now on this page goes to the contact form, so it is recorded as enquiry only; the general Peek link in the site header may also sell it. No price on the site. Days are Tuesdays and Saturdays.

trips.title: Private Charters
trips.summary: Private hire of one of the catamarans for a wedding, a corporate function or a family celebration. The team can arrange live music, a barbecue and catering to suit.
highlights: Live music, barbecues and specialised catering
trips.checkNotes: Enquiry form on the page, or email privatecharters@amazing-attractions.com. No prices shown.

checkNotes: No prices anywhere on the site; scheduled cruises are sold through Peek (book.peek.com links, not opened), and the header Book Online button goes to a general Peek page: https://book.peek.com/s/d9e5409e-49c3-403f-8449-e1bfda286ff0/Rx6X4. Contact emails use the amazing-attractions.com domain (reservations@, contact@ and privatecharters@), so Tiami appears to be run under Amazing Attractions; confirm the trading entity. Home page says the fleet is eight catamarans. Footer copyright 2024, gallery photos uploaded February 2025, home page modified January 2026; the Google review widget shows reviews from October 2022 only.
